comparison.objective: Release a bit from an unpowered keyless drill and place it in a tray; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a loose drill while hand-twisting its chuck sleeve, then extract the bit; candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening a separate jam nut with two tools.
comparison.success_condition: Bit is wholly outside the chuck, stowed, and all objects are released and still; candidate must preserve a target angle and prove retention through three cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared counterhold-and-twist primitive is generic; chuck release tests jaw opening and extraction, not preserving a continuous setting against locknut reaction and verifying drift.
